messages:
sam: PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3421 — addressed your comments: moved the feature flag into the config object, kept the old env var as a fallback, and added a migration test + docs. Hoping to merge before tomorrow's canary window. Need 1 approval.
maria: quick q — does the fallback env var still accept legacy values or do we normalize? I want to be sure we don't break any internal deploy scripts.
sam: good call — it normalizes to lowercase and maps 'ON'/'1' -> true; we also emit a deprecation log at init. Unit test covers legacy values.
pranav: running the smoke locally now, will ping if anything obvious.
ci-bot: CI: unit & lint ✅, integration flaky test failed on first run, rerun queued.
pranav: reran the flaky integration job, all checks green now. smoke looks fine on my mac M1.
sam: pushed a tiny follow-up to move normalization off the hot path per perf convo.
jen: skimmed the diff — looks reasonable. PTAL @alex for the runtime perf tradeoff on the init change.
alex: quick perf note: the normalization in init adds ~40us to cold-start; acceptable for canary, but could defer to config load thread. Otherwise :+1:.
sam: thanks — I pushed the deferred normalization change and a comment explaining why.
jen: LGTM. :thumbsup: I'll approve on GH.
sam: awesome, thank you!! planning to merge immediately after the 09:00 PT canary slot.
merge-bot: merge-scheduler: PR #3421 scheduled for canary window 2024-06-12T16:00Z (auto-merge will run if all checks stay green).
